question:
What is the mean of mode, median and range of the data given below ?

9, 11, 4, 7, 10, 23, 21, 29, 23, 33, 18
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Arrange the data in ascending order: 4, 7, 9, 10, 11, 18, 21, 23, 23, 29, 33.

Mode = Most frequent term = 23.

Median = Middle (6th) term = 18.

Range = Maximum − Minimum = 33 − 4 = 29.

Required Mean = (23 + 18 + 29) ÷ 3 = 70/3.

**∴ The correct answer is 70/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data set: 9, 11, 4, 7, 10, 23, 21, 29, 23, 33, 18

**Formula Used:**

Mean = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

Median (for odd n) = ((n + 1) ÷ 2)th observation

Range = Maximum value − Minimum value

Mode = Observation with the highest frequency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sorted data: 4, 7, 9, 10, 11, 18, 21, 23, 23, 29, 33

⇒ Number of terms (n) = 11

⇒ Median = ((11 + 1) ÷ 2)th term = 6th term = 18

⇒ The number 23 appears maximum times (2 times), so Mode = 23

⇒ Minimum value = 4 and Maximum value = 33

⇒ Range = 33 − 4 = 29

⇒ Required Mean = (Mode + Median + Range) ÷ 3

⇒ Required Mean = (23 + 18 + 29) ÷ 3 = 70 ÷ 3 = 70/3

**∴ The correct answer is 70/3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean

Mean (Average) is the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations. Formula: Mean = Sum ÷ n.

Median

For a sorted data set, if the number of terms (n) is odd, Median = ((n+1) ÷ 2)th term. If n is even, Median is the average of (n ÷ 2)th and (n ÷ 2 + 1)th terms.

Mode

Mode is the value that appears most frequently in a data set. A set may have one mode, more than one mode, or no mode at all.

Range

Range is the difference between the highest and lowest values in the data set. It provides a quick measure of data spread.
